algorithm.allocation: per-stratum minimum of 1 where feasible, then largest remainder against proportional quotas; ties -> larger pool, then stratum name
algorithm.eligibility_rule: one raw QA name, exactly one source PDF candidate with audit status verified_complete, and a gt reference; missing or empty OCR never excludes
algorithm.exclusion_rule: documents selected by the named frozen pilots are removed from the eligible pool before allocation
algorithm.identity_rule: canonical doc id = NFC of the gt inventory key the QA doc_name resolves to (exact, documented alias, or Unicode NFC), as recorded by the asset audit
algorithm.inputs_used: document identity, doc type and source status only; never answers, evidence strings, string-match results or model outputs
algorithm.name: stratified-hash-rank-v1
algorithm.page_rule: documents with at least 2 PDF pages
algorithm.pool_rule: documents with at least one validation question
algorithm.within_stratum: ascending sha256(seed, 'select', doc_id); independent of input order
